verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a financial and developer platform like Circle, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documented bulk or self-serve export of a user's data in open formats. List APIs such as retrieving wallet sets are developer building blocks, USDC redeemability concerns funds rather than data, and self-managed custody is an adjacent feature; none of these count as an export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
